source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Alcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesFINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe EditionReleases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe EditionAlcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingView DLCHope resonates within the crystalsThis product is a bundle that includes the FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE base game along with the Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack, which contains an item that transforms your chocobo's appearance into magitek armor, an item exclusive to this pack that unlocks a certain character's Fel Meteor Limit Burst, and useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Digital Deluxe Edition Contents: ▼ FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Base Game ▼ Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack Pack Contents: • Magitek Armor Key x1 • Archwitch’s Grimoire x1 • Mastery Ring x1 • Tent x5 • Mist Potion x5 • Mist Ether x5 • Phoenix Down x5 • Remedy x3 *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The chocobo’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Armor Key “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.FINAL FANTASY RESONANCEGamesFINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe UpgradeGamesPublisher notification(s):Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter PackThis set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Magitek Airship Passkey x1• Knight’s Greatsword x1• Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount)• Magicite Shard x1• Tent x3• Mist Potion x3*These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart PackThis set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount)• Mist Ether x1*These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 5, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *This product is a bundle that includes FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, playable only on Nintendo Switch™ 2, and additional content pertaining to that title. *This product is not compatible with the FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe Upgrade released for Nintendo Switch™. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases or purchasing the wrong product.*The content included in this bundle is also sold separately. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.About this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreSystemNintendo Switch 2PublisherSQUARE ENIXSupported languagesJapanese, French, German, Spanish, American EnglishRelease dateOctober 22, 2026ESRB ratingAlcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesDownloadable content (DLC)FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe UpgradeReleases 10/22/26Regular Price:$14.99GamesWARNING: If you have epilepsy or have had seizures or other unusual reactions to flashing lights or patterns, consult a doctor before playing video games. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.It's possible that information related to the game, including ratings and download size, may not be finalized at time of preorder.

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9Mild ViolenceGamesNintendo Switch Sports Resort™Releases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Nintendo Switch Sports Resort™Mild ViolenceLoadingFace off in 12 motion-control sports on an island getaway!Welcome to Spocco Resort! Dive into a variety of sports with intuitive motion controls that make it easy for anyone to pick up. Play casually with friends*, on your own, or turn up the heat in the ranked online** Pro League. From fast-paced matches to secret island surprises, there are plenty of ways to play, connect, and explore.Exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 systemWatch trailerSave with the bundleGameplay featuring a two adults racing on Power Cruisers that then cuts into a family of four going head to head in tennis. Get a friendly rivalry going—and the whole family movingEnjoy classic sports including Archery, Basketball, Boxing, and Tennis, along with new ones like Skateboarding and Thumb Wrestling. Play ‘em solo or with friends—online or on the same system.TennisBowlingArcheryBoxingVolleyballTable TennisBasketballGolfThumb WrestlingProp PlaneSkateboardingPower CruisingPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemIt’s easy to share the fun! Choose from nine sports and enjoy relaxed matches with players worldwide.Nintendo Switch Online membership required.Learn more >Pro LeagueChallenge players from around the world in the online Pro League! Go head-to-head with competitors who match your skill level as you vie for the top spot.Explore Wuhu Island by land, sea, and airTake in scenic views as you uncover sightseeing spots in different ways: Power Cruise through the open water, Skateboard across the resort, or fly through the sky in a Prop Plane.Split screen gameplay of two sports mates flying toward a cityscape in the game. Be a tourist (on a mission)Discover the island on a Sightseeing Tour as you complete challenges, collect Spocco Photos, and more.Play as a Sportsmate or Mii characterBring out your creative sideBring out your creative sideCreate and customize your character’s look to capture your personal style!
